name: 2C-B
identity: A synthetic psychedelic phenethylamine with stimulant-like and perception-altering effects.

safetyClaims.title: Identity and potency may be uncertain
safetyClaims.body: Products sold as 2C-B can be misrepresented, and relatively small quantity differences may change intensity.
safetyClaims.action: Treat appearance and seller claims as uncertain; avoid combinations and seek help for severe signs.
